channel.title: Claude News
channel.description: News, announcements, and stories from Anthropic about Claude and the people building with it.

item.title: Operate Claude Managed Agents inside your security perimeter
item.description: Introducing self-hosted Claude Managed Agents. Now you can run agents in your own environment, whether that’s in your own cloud or on-premise. You host the agents, credentials, and session history, and choose where requests to Claude are sent.

item.title: The Claude Tag guide for startups
item.description: How leading startups use Claude Tag to ship faster and scale operations

item.title: Building always-on agents
item.description: Always-on agents run indefinitely, deciding how and when to act across many sessions. This guide walks through their core primitives and how they fit together.

item.title: Building strong safety evaluations
item.description: Recommendations for designing, running, and reporting safety evaluations, based on our own experiences.

item.title: How the Claude Code team thinks about verification
item.description: How end-to-end, property and differential tests let coding agents verify their work with evidence, and what the Claude Code team does to keep its verifiers honest.

item.title: Using a "chaos loop" to harden the Claude Docs launch: 60 server errors across billions of requests
item.description: How Claude spent two weeks load testing a staging cluster, breaking the Claude Docs service on purpose and fixing what fell over before launch, and what made the service legible enough for Claude to close the loop.

item.title: Linked billing on the Claude Platform
Introducing Claude Ship
item.description: Open a pull request and get back to building. Claude can now review pull requests, fix them, and approve the ones that a team's policy allows.

item.title: The enterprise guide to securing coding agents
item.description: How security and technical leaders can understand and bound risk as they scale Claude Code

item.title: Zero data retention with Enterprise Frontier Safeguards is now in beta
KPMG's Todd Lohr on AI when your data is also your clients' data
item.description: Todd Lohr, KPMG US Vice Chair and Head of Client Technology & Innovation, on adopting frontier AI and building safeguards at the same time, and what that means for a firm that holds its clients' most sensitive data.
